warning.titlePre: Mercedes ML63 AMG Camshaft Adjuster & Head Bolt Wear
paragraphs: If your ML63 AMG is a pre-2012 model with the M156 6.2-litre V8 — that's the W164 generation — camshaft adjuster and head bolt wear is a well-documented pattern on this AMG engine, backed by specialist consensus. We replace worn camshaft adjusters, timing chain components and bearings as standard on every M156 rebuild.
The later W166-generation M-Class (2011–2015) does not use the M156 — it switched to the M157 biturbo V8 for the ML63 AMG, which is a different engine with its own separate service requirements.
warning.source: Source: established AMG specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-m-class.md. Correctly scoped to the pre-2012 W164 generation
